name: Church of St Francis of Assisi
notes: No evening Mass on public holidays.
The Blessed Sacrament room is permanently closed from 16 Nov 2026.

info.adoration: The Blessed Sacrament room is permanently closed from 16 Nov 2026. The church is open daily 06:30–21:00 except public holidays for prayer.
info.confession: Confession is 15 minutes before Mass or by appointment.
devotions: Holy Mercy Prayer Group and Purgatorial Souls Prayer Group: All Souls' remembrance after Chinese Mass every Sunday in November at the basement columbarium.
Family Rosary Novena: 20:00 online, 17–25 Nov and 27 Nov.
info.office_hours: Parish office: 62640078. Church doors open daily 06:00–22:00; on Sundays they close after the 19:30 Mass. Closed on public holidays.
good_to_know: Anointing of the Sick: contact the parish office before surgery; major surgery can be arranged at home, minor in church.
Infant Baptism: application form at www.csfa.sg. Date: 9 Jan 2027 (Saturday).
Marriage: enquire at the parish office at least 1 year in advance.
Funerals: contact the parish office before arranging with a funeral director.
